source.title: New named Dragonflight processing originals and item-side Looter lineage check

notes: Genuine fresh item-name search across Wowhead, Reddit, Blizzard forums, Warcraft Wiki and WoW-Professions. All seven newly surfaced source-reported gear denominators/material hits duplicate existing original item-side Looter samples; PTR/live mirrors and newer display captures are not new cohorts. No independently new source-original ore-prospect or herb-mill per-completed-operation dataset. Completed casts, refund-adjusted denominators, individual material totalQuantity, castsWithDrop and zero-inclusive 0..N histograms remain unknown where not previously reported. Do not convert stated per-input or pooled gem share into P(at least one output per cast); no measured numeric fields added.
